title: Marrow Retail late sales reports postmortem
brief: Please write the postmortem for INC-3302 at Marrow Retail, the late nightly sales reports on 2026-10-06, owned by the Data Platform team. Numbers first: the reports were due at 03:00 UTC and went out at 11:40, 8 hours 40 minutes late; 214 store managers received empty or stale reports; the backfill took 95 minutes. What happened, for a "Summary" section: the point-of-sale vendor added a column named tender_subtype to the sales feed without notice, the ingestion job failed on it, and because the failure alert went to a retired channel, nobody knew until a store manager asked why the report was empty. Then "Timeline" in UTC: 01:15 vendor deploys the schema change; 02:10 ingestion job fails for the first time; 02:40 retries exhausted; 03:00 reports miss their deadline, no alert; 07:25 a store manager asks in #retail-ops why the report is empty; 07:50 support pages the Data Platform on-call; 08:35 cause identified; 09:20 schema mapping patched; 10:05 backfill starts; 11:40 reports published. A "Contributing factors" section: the alert still routed to the retired channel #data-alerts-old, there was no schema contract check on vendor feeds, and the backfill ran serially. A "What went well" section: once paged, the on-call found the cause in 45 minutes, and no wrong numbers were published. Finish with "Action items", each with an owner and due date: route pipeline alerts to the on-call pager, Samuel Achterberg, 2026-10-16; add a schema contract check on vendor feeds, Lucia Fontaine, 2026-11-06; parallelize the backfill by partition, Data Platform on-call, 2026-11-20; require 14 days' notice of feed changes in the vendor contract, Vendor Management, 2026-10-30. Blameless tone.

edit.request: Add an action item "Review alert routing every quarter", owner Wen Zhao, due 2026-12-11, and correct the number of store managers to 231.
